test_GoGameLogic_valid_moves: test the GoGameLogic class by applying valid GoMarkerAction moves on a 5x5 board
test_GoGameLogic_pass_action: test the GoGameLogic pass action by applying a GoMarkerAction with pass_action set to True
test_GoGameLogic_invalid_moves: test that GoGameLogic rejects invalid moves like placing on an occupied cell
test_GoGTPOpponent_vs_random: test GoGTPOpponent against GoRandomOpponent by playing full games and checking reward outcomes
test_go_marker_serialization: test the round-trip serialization of GoMarkerAction to int and string representations
